priorityList: --- Icy Veins Spellslinger Rotation (Hero-Spec Specific) ---
Cast Arcane Orb when you have Clearcasting and your previous spell was Arcane Barrage.
Cast Arcane Barrage when you have 4 Arcane Charge stacks and 20 stacks of Arcane Salvo.
Cast Arcane Barrage when you have 4 Arcane Charge stacks and 25 Arcane Salvo stacks.
Cast Arcane Pulse when you have 0-2 Arcane Charge stacks.
Cast Arcane Blast as your filler.
Cast Arcane Barrage if you do not have enough mana for Arcane Blast.
Use any potions, racials or other items that buff your damage/stats that last 15 seconds or longer before Arcane Surge.
Cast Arcane Surge.
Use any potions, racials or other items that last less than 15 seconds after Arcane Surge.
Cast Touch of the Magi.

45 seconds later, cast Touch of the Magi when it is ready. You can do this once in-between Arcane Surge uses. It has exactly half the cooldown of Arcane Surge, so try not to delay it much, as it will force you to delay your next Arcane Surge as well.
--- WoWhead Spellslinger Opener ---
Cast Arcane Blast 2 seconds before pulling.
Cast Arcane Orb and Time Warp.
Cast Arcane Blast until you have 20 stacks of Arcane Salvo.
Use any potions, items, or trinkets that will buff you for more than 15 seconds.
Cast Arcane Surge.
Use any potions, items, or trinkets that will buff you for less than or equal to 15 seconds.
Cast Arcane Barrage and then Touch of the Magi while it is mid-air.
45-seconds later, when Touch of the Magis cooldown finishes, repeat the last step.

Use any potions, racials, items, or trinkets that buff your stats so that they will last through Touch of the Magi. As examples; if its a 30-second effect, you can use it before Arcane Surge; if its an 8-second effect you should use it when Touch of the Magi has around 8 seconds remaining; and a 15-second effect would be best used 3 seconds before using Touch of the Magi.
Cast Arcane Surge, this can be your prepull cast.
Cast Time Warp and do follow the rotation until it's time to touch, but remember to hold 25 Arcane Salvo stacks for Touch.
Cast Touch of the Magi when Arcane Surge has 4-6 seconds remaining.
45-seconds later, when Touch of the Magis cooldown finishes, use it!
--- WoWhead Spellslinger Rotation ---
Cast Arcane Orb whenever you have just cast Arcane Barrage and have Clearcasting.
Cast Arcane Barrage with 4x Arcane Charges if you have 20 stacks of Arcane Salvo.
Cast Arcane Pulse if you have 3 or more targets.
Cast Arcane Blast.
Cast Arcane Barrage if you don't have enough mana for Arcane Blast.
Cast Arcane Barrage with 4x Arcane Charges if you have 20 stacks of Arcane Salvo.
Cast Arcane Barrage with 4x Arcane Charges if you have 5 or more Arcane Salvo, Clearcasting, and Overpowered Missiles.
Cast Arcane Missiles whenever less than 10 stacks of Arcane Salvo or less than 3x Arcane Charges.
Cast Arcane Orb whenever you have less than 4x Arcane Charges.
Cast Arcane Pulse if you have 3 or more targets.
Cast Arcane Blast.
Cast Arcane Barrage if you don't have enough mana for Arcane Blast.
Cast Arcane Missiles if you have Clearcasting and Arcane Surge is about to end.
Cast Arcane Barrage with 4x Arcane Charges if you have just cast Touch of the Magi or it is about to end.
Cast Arcane Barrage with 4x Arcane Charges if you have 25 stacks of Arcane Salvo.

Cast Arcane Barrage with 4x Arcane Charges, less than 19 stacks of Arcane Salvo, and a Clearcasting proc or, if you have also have 3 or more enemies, you can do this with an available Arcane Orb charge.
Cast Arcane Missiles whenever you have Clearcasting.
Cast Arcane Orb whenever you have less than 2x Arcane Charges.
Cast Arcane Pulse if you have 3 or more targets.
Cast Arcane Blast.
Cast Arcane Barrage if you don't have enough mana for Arcane Blast.
